出版者的话
古希腊圣哲亚里士多德曾说：“任何人都会生气，这没什么难的，但若要适时适所地以适当方式对对象恰如其分地生气，可就难上加难了。”我们现在讲的情绪管理指的就是要适时适所地对适当对象恰如其分地表达情绪。
现实生活中，人们越来越多地认识到情绪管理能力的重要性，因为这方面能力出众的人往往在各个领域都游刃有余；相反，此项能力差的人，虽然可能很聪明，但做起事来往往很吃力。
情绪管理能力虽部分得益于先天因素，但归根结底还得靠后天的学习和培养。幼儿时期是情绪管理能力培养的黄金时期。一个人在幼儿时期所获得的情绪经验和习惯会在大脑中形成永久的神经联结，对其身心发展影响很长远。
当前，亲子共读情绪管理类图画书这种情绪管理能力培养方式已被广泛认可。优质的图画书好比幸福的种子，通过父母的声音飞进孩子的耳朵里，植根在孩子的心底，施以阳光，而露就能生根、发芽。
这套有趣的动物图画故事书温情脉脉，每一本都是有针对性地就孩子的某一种情绪话题展开，描绘孩子的心理历程，揭示其走出情绪困扰并解决问题的过程。每一本书都附有幼教专家精心撰写的导读，可作为家长亲子共读时的参考。
让我们在这套书的陪伴下，去享受一段美妙的亲子阅读之旅吧！
page_text_en:
Publisher's Note
The ancient Greek philosopher Aristotle once said: 'Everyone gets angry, and that's not difficult. But to be angry at the right time, in the right place, with the right person, and in the right way, that's difficult.' What we now call emotional management refers precisely to expressing emotions appropriately, at the right time and place, toward the right person.
In real life, people are increasingly recognizing the importance of emotional management skills. Those who excel in this area often thrive in various fields; conversely, those who lack this ability, though perhaps intelligent, often struggle in their endeavors.
While emotional management skills may partly stem from innate factors, they ultimately depend on learning and cultivation after birth. Early childhood is the golden period for developing emotional management skills. The emotional experiences and habits acquired during childhood form permanent neural connections in the brain, profoundly influencing physical and mental development.
Currently, the method of parent-child co-reading emotional management picture books is widely recognized as an effective way to cultivate emotional management skills. High-quality picture books are like seeds of happiness, carried by parents' voices into children's ears, taking root in their hearts, nourished by sunlight, and sprouting with dew.
This series of heartwarming animal story picture books addresses specific emotional topics for children, depicting their psychological journeys and revealing how they overcome emotional challenges and solve problems. Each book includes a carefully written guide by early childhood education experts, serving as a reference for parents during shared reading.
Let us enjoy a wonderful journey of parent-child reading together with this series!
summary_zh: 本页为《小猪一点也不脏》一书的出版者的话，阐述了情绪管理的重要性，强调幼儿时期是培养情绪管理能力的关键阶段，并介绍了该系列图画书的教育价值和亲子共读的意义。

page_text_en:
Teacher Says to You
Building Bridges of Friendship Through Communication
In our conventional mindset, the image of a pig, while not particularly terrible, certainly doesn't qualify as 'clean,' due to our habits. But even so, can we be sure our views are always correct?
As we ponder this, perhaps the little animals in the picture book story 'The Pig Is Not Dirty at All' are secretly laughing! Why? Because they once viewed their friend—Pig Rosetta Banana—exactly this way. As a result, they almost lost a good friend and a joyful afternoon filled with the scents of citron, jasmine, and mint.
Rosetta Banana is an elegant, chubby, and adorable little pig. However, after arriving at her new school, a whole week passed and she hadn't made a single friend! Whenever she walked past her classmates, they would whisper, calling her a dirty little pig. It's no wonder she felt so downcast. Later, angry, she transformed from a gentle pig into a grumpy one. She shouted at her classmates, 'I'm not dirty!' But the classmates still thought she wasn't clean. Especially the mocking words from duck Caesar deeply hurt her. She ran away crying, not understanding why her classmates treated her this way.
Only when little sheep Mianmian took the initiative to walk up and comfort her did things begin to turn around. In Mianmian's care
summary_zh: 本页为绘本《小猪一点也不脏》的导读页，通过讲述主角小猪罗塞塔·芭娜娜因被误解为‘脏’而感到沮丧，最终在小羊绵绵的安慰下迎来转机的故事，强调了沟通在建立友谊中的重要性。

source_file: 小猪一点都不脏（2-5 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
心下，小猪试探性地说出了自己的疑惑：“你觉得我身上难闻吗？”通过与绵绵的坦诚沟通，她终于明白为什么同学们会误会自己了。于是，在绵绵的建议下，她决定举办一场泥巴派对，来消除同学们对自己的误会。

最终，一场散发着芳香的泥巴浴，改变了同学们对罗塞塔·芭娜娜的错误看法，他们在一起度过了一个快乐又美好的午后。当然，罗塞塔也成了大家的好朋友。

《小猪一点也不脏》用生动的文字、温暖的图画，为我们讲述了一个小猪交朋友的故事。通过这个故事，我们知道了，由于认知上的差异，我们每个人都有可能被他人误解。但是，只要我们保持一颗乐于沟通的心，积极倾听他人的想法，就可以消除别人对我们的误解，我们与他人之间也就能架起一座友谊的桥梁。

孩子们，如果你们在交朋友时遇到了一些小挫折，请不要灰心，要相信自己，主动寻求沟通的机会，这样，你就能收获友谊。

（保定市青年路幼儿园 张艳荣）
page_text_en:
In her heart, the little pig tentatively voiced her doubt: "Do you think I smell bad?" Through honest communication with Mianmian, she finally understood why her classmates had misunderstood her. So, following Mianmian's suggestion, she decided to host a mud party to clear up the misunderstanding.

In the end, a mud bath filled with fragrance changed her classmates' wrong perception of Rosetta Banana. They spent a happy and wonderful afternoon together. Of course, Rosetta also became everyone's good friend.

"The Pig Isn't Dirty at All" tells a story of a little pig making friends with vivid text and warm illustrations. Through this story, we learn that due to differences in perception, each of us might be misunderstood by others. However, as long as we keep a heart open to communication and actively listen to others' thoughts, we can eliminate misunderstandings and build a bridge of friendship between us.

Children, if you encounter small setbacks when making friends, don't lose heart. Believe in yourself, actively seek opportunities to communicate, and you will gain friendship.

(Baoding Youth Road Kindergarten, Zhang Yanrong)
summary_zh: 本页为绘本《小猪一点也不脏》的导读或推荐语，总结了小猪通过沟通消除误会、交到朋友的故事，并鼓励孩子们在交友中主动沟通、建立友谊。

page_text_en:
Rosetta couldn't stand it when others said she was dirty! She even wanted to run away from school.
Rosetta had always been a very gentle little pig. But this time, she felt she was about to become a grumpy pig!
"I'm not dirty at all!" Rosetta shouted.
"You can come over and smell! 
I smell of bananas, shy grass, camellias, and magnolias! How could I possibly stink!"
summary_zh: 小猪罗塞塔因被同学说脏而感到委屈和愤怒，她大声辩解自己身上有各种花果的香味，并质问为何会被认为臭，表现出她内心的不平与渴望被理解的心情。
